browser-address-suggestions.description: Allows the trusted browser address suggestion surface to emit selection events only.

default.description: Default desktop window permissions. Bound to the main WebView label so child browser WebViews get zero IPC.

detached.description: Permissions for pop-out detached windows (terminal sessions / connections page). These windows host the same backend session state as the main window but render an isolated UI, so they need at least the default IPC + event-listening set plus the ability to create/close windows.
